description.zh: 问题分类ID, 从ListCategories接口中获取返回值CategoryId
description.en: The ID of the issue category. Obtain this ID from the ListCategories operation.

description.zh: 提交账号的阿里云uid，MPK虚商场景需要
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account that submits the ticket. This parameter is required for Marketplace reseller scenarios.

description.zh: 工单问题描述, 目前只支持纯文本格式
description.en: The description of the issue in the ticket. Only plain text is supported.

description.zh: 用户提交工单的联系邮箱地址。
description.en: The contact email address for the ticket.

description.zh: 附件名称列表，GetAttachmentUploadUrl接口返回的ObjectKey字段
description.en: A list of attachment names. Use the ObjectKey value returned by the GetAttachmentUploadUrl operation.

description.zh: 枚举值, 1 代表一般问题, 2 代表紧急问题
description.en: An enumeration value. A value of 1 indicates a normal issue. A value of 2 indicates an urgent issue.
